in_sanskrit.name: Ayanit

in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayanit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ayanit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ayana' which means 'Sky'. This name is given to a boy born under the sky or in the sky. In Hindu mythology, Ayanit is the name of a celestial being, a god of the sky or the wind. He is depicted as a young boy, riding a chariot drawn by horses or eagles.
